title: Making a Full Bridge Rectifier
summary: ElectroBOOM's Mehdi Sadaghdar explains how a full bridge rectifier works, the building block of AC to DC converters, with his usual humor and a demonstration of the circuit.
why: Recommended as an enlightening and funny explanation of bridge rectifiers, often linked in power supply teardown threads.

quote.text: The linked video of how bridge rectifier works is enlightening, funny and terrifying.
